intro.text: The Desolation that began when Chanarach broke on Braize, allowing the Fused to return.

description.text: The Night of Sorrows is one part of the conflict, not another name for all of it.

items.text: Shallan's killing of her mother Chanarach returned the Herald to Braize.
Chanarach broke under torture, allowing the Fused to return after Talenel had held alone for millennia.
The stormform listeners summoned the Everstorm at Narak.
The storm restored the singers' minds and allowed Fused to return in singer bodies.
